sloka: यदि न प्रत्ययोऽस्मासु विक्रमे तव वानर ।प्रत्ययं समरे श्लाघ्यमहमुत्पादयामि ते ॥४-११-८३॥।।
transliteration: yadi na pratyayo'smāsu vikrame tava vānara ।pratyayaṁ samare ślāghyamahamutpādayāmi te ॥4-11-83॥।।

translations.english: 'If you have no confidence in my strength in fight, O monkey, I will create it in you so much so that you will admire it.'
